title: Renting for two people
_dead_note: The capture opens and closes on the macOS wallpaper, with white flash frames between it and the app. Scene 1 starts at 2.6s and the last scene ends at 104.37s, so no junk is inside any segment. The MASTER is untouched.
_frames_note: `frames` on each scene is its own footage at 30fps — the rate was MEASURED, never assumed 25.

scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Renting for two. {0.3} Enter your email to sign in.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty, so add the first person to it.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection, and choose your own gear from inside it.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Pick your pickup day, then your return day. {0.3} We hold the gear for every day between.

scenes.label: party-members
scenes.line: Now invite the second person to the same order.

scenes.label: member-two-added
scenes.line: They are on the order too.

scenes.label: second-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection again, and choose their gear the same way.

scenes.label: second-dates
scenes.line: Their dates are picked on their own calendar, so the two of you can rent over different days.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Now the questions, one set per person, so every pair of skis is fitted before you arrive. {0.3} Height, boot size, skill level, weight and age for you. {0.3} Then the same for your party member, on their own card below yours. {0.3} We set the bindings from these numbers, which is why we ask. {0.3} Agree to the terms for both of you, and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: One payment covers the whole order, for everybody on it.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Both rentals sit in your order history, ready for your next trip.
